claim_text: Magnesium glycinate provides elemental magnesium, but dietary adequacy and supplemental exposure must be assessed using the elemental magnesium amount; a sleep benefit should not be assumed solely from the glycinate form.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent duplicate supplementation and unsupported wellness claims; support safe total-intake assessment.

population.other_context: People considering magnesium glycinate because of a perceived dietary gap.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Magnesium fact sheet describes dietary sources, supplemental forms and upper limits.
limitations: No dose from this claim; renal function and medication context can change safety.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
